department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Help for first-generation business owners to start a manufacturing or service unit. The project can cost Rs 10 lakh to Rs 5 crore. The government pays 25% of the project cost as a subsidy, up to Rs 75 lakh. You also get 3% interest help for the whole loan period.

other: You must be a first-generation entrepreneur.
Age 21 to 45. For women, BC, MBC, SC, ST, ex-servicemen, transgender people and people with disabilities, the upper age is 55.
You must have passed +2, or have a degree, diploma, ITI or vocational training.
You put in 10% of the project cost yourself (5% for special categories).

documents: School or college Transfer Certificate or record sheet
Ration card, or nativity certificate, Aadhaar or voter ID
how_to_apply: Apply online only, on the MSME Department website msmeonline.tn.gov.in.
